pending: No Catalina screenshot shows AppKit's round button (spec: round-button, not seen), so the bezel has no reference crop to compare with: its comparisons below are pixel checks against the values the spec infers from the help button. Only the destructive variant, which Contacts draws, is compared with a screenshot (contacts-remove-light).

comparisons.name: rest-light
comparisons.description: Regular, disabled, small and mini round buttons at rest, Aqua. Every value is inferred from the help button: no screenshot shows a round button.

pixels.note: fill of the bezel (spec: help-button, Fill, measured; that the round button shares it is inferred)
side edge of the bezel over the page (spec: help-button, Edge, measured as #c3c3c3 over #ececec and #2b2b2b over #303031)
top edge (spec: help-button, Edge)
bottom edge: a 20 pt bezel in the 21 pt box (spec: Diameter, regular, inferred from the help button)
disabled fill: the bezel at half opacity over the page (spec: push-button, Fill, disabled; inferred for this control)
bottom edge of the small bezel: 17 pt in an 18 pt box (spec: Diameter, small, inferred)
bottom edge of the mini bezel: 14 pt in a 15 pt box (spec: Diameter, mini, inferred)
fill of the small bezel
fill of the mini bezel

comparisons.name: pressed-light
comparisons.description: The regular button held down with the mouse, Aqua.

pixels.note: pressed fill: the shared pressed bezel, --mac-bezel-fill-pressed, #f0f0f0 (spec: tokens.md, inferred). The help-button page of the spec, which the round button follows, infers a darker #e5e5e5; the two pages disagree and no screenshot settles it, so this pixel holds the component to the token sheet, not to that page
the disabled button does not change

comparisons.name: focus-ring-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the regular button, reached with Tab, Aqua.

pixels.note: ring over the page, measured on a text field (spec: focus-ring, sRGB); its circular shape is inferred
the ring is circular: the same band above the top of the bezel
page just outside the ring: it ends 2.5 pt beyond the edge of the bezel (spec: focus-ring, Geometry)
page at the corner of the box: the ring follows the circle

comparisons.name: window-inactive-light
comparisons.description: The same after Tab in an inactive window, Aqua.

pixels.note: no focus ring outside the key window (spec: focus-ring, States)
the bezel does not change in an inactive window (spec: help-button, States, inferred)
